ghi_chu: Bang chung ro rang 'bai bo Dieu 12 va Dieu 19' = tung phan cu the, khop huong Gemini (BaiBoTungPhan), 'truoc khi sua' SuaDoi cung cung nhom tung-phan nen khong sai chuc nang

Dieu 2 nguon: 'Bai bo Dieu 22 cua Thong tu so 07/2015/TT-NHNN' = tung phan ro rang. 'Truoc khi sua' la BaiBoToanBo (toan bo) - SAI, can sua sang tung phan. Neu rule ap dung BaiBoTungPhan (Gemini) thi la sua DUNG mot loi that su.
Dieu 7 nguon liet ke cu the 'Bai bo Dieu 4, khoan 2 Dieu 5...' = tung phan. Truoc khi sua SuaDoi (tung phan) da dung san, khop huong Gemini.
Dieu 2 nguon: 'Bai bo diem b khoan 1, diem b khoan 2 va khoan 5 Dieu 34' = tung phan cu the. Truoc khi sua SuaDoi (tung phan) dung, khop Gemini.
Dieu 2 nguon: 'Bai bo Phu luc so 02 va Phu luc so 03' = tung phan cu the. Truoc khi sua SuaDoi dung, khop Gemini.

Dieu 22 nguon: 'Bai bo khoan 13 Dieu 3 va Mau so 02' = tung phan cu the. Truoc khi sua SuaDoi dung, khop Gemini. (Luu y: toan van co loi OCR nang - 'Nghi dinh so 26/2016' phai la 96/2016 - nhung khong anh huong ket luan)

Muc V.5 nguon: 'Thong tu nay thay the cac Thong tu sau: ... Thong tu so 03/2002/TT-BLDTBXH...' = tuyen bo thay the TOAN BO ro rang, liet ke nhieu VB cu bi thay. Truoc khi sua ThayThe dung, khop Gemini.

QUAN TRONG: nguon 682/QD-BTC la VAN BAN CONG BO/DANH MUC cac VB da het hieu luc (liet ke ma khong tu minh tuyen bo thay the) - chinh DeepSeek tu nhan xet 'nguon khong phai la van ban thay the, chi la van ban cong bo het hieu luc' nhung van gan nham BaiBoToanBo. Day la mau hinh moi giong VBHN (van ban tong hop/danh muc khong phai la nguon hop le) - dung ra nen la KhongLienQuan (hoac can rule rieng cho loai VB 'cong bo/danh muc het hieu luc'), khong phai ThayThe/BaiBoToanBo nhu ca 2 model va graph truoc do deu gan.
Dieu 1 nguon: 'Quy che cho vay...ban hanh theo Quyet dinh nay thay the cho Quy che cho vay...ban hanh theo Quyet dinh so 284/2000' = thay the TOAN BO ro rang. Truoc khi sua ThayThe dung, khop Gemini.

Muc III.1 nguon: 'Thong tu nay thay the NOI DUNG HUONG DAN VE LE PHI CHUNG THUC...' = pham vi HEP theo chu de cu the, khong phai toan bo. Truoc khi sua ThayThe (toan bo) SAI, can sua sang tung phan (BaiBoTungPhan/SuaDoi theo Gemini) - day la sua DUNG mot loi that su.
Khoan cuoi nguon: 'Thong tu nay thay the Thong tu so 213/2000/TT-BGTVT...' = thay the TOAN BO khong dieu kien. Truoc khi sua ThayThe dung, khop Gemini.
Trung lap voi ca 1 (cung nguon/dich, action_id khac) - cung bang chung 'bai bo Dieu 12 va Dieu 19' = tung phan, khop huong Gemini, truoc khi sua SuaDoi da dung san.
Khong doc duoc day du ly do Gemini (bi cat trong ban trich) va chua doc toan van 45577 ky tu de xac nhan toan bo vs tung phan - can doc them truoc khi ket luan chac chan.

Dieu 2 nguon: 'Bai bo: khoan 1 Dieu 30 va Chuong IX Nghi dinh so 84/2015/NĐ-CP' = tung phan cu the. Truoc khi sua da la BaiBoTungPhan (tung phan) - da dung san, khop Gemini, khong can sua gi ve chuc nang.
Muc VIII 'DIEU KHOAN THI HANH' nguon: 'Thong tu nay thay the cac Thong tu: ... Thong tu so 06/GD-DT...' = thay the TOAN BO ro rang, liet ke nhieu VB cu. Truoc khi sua ThayThe dung, khop Gemini.

Dieu II.1 nguon: 'Bai bo cac quy dinh VE VIEC CAP GIAY CHUNG NHAN QUYEN SO HUU NHA O tai Thong tu so 13/2005...' = pham vi HEP theo chu de (dich con dieu chinh nhieu noi dung khac). Truoc khi sua BaiBoToanBo (toan bo) co the SAI, can sua sang tung phan - neu rule ap dung tung-phan thi la sua DUNG mot loi that su.
Dieu 38 nguon: 'bai bo mot so doan cu the tai khoan 6 Dieu 14a va tai Mau so 03' = tung phan cu the. Truoc khi sua SuaDoi (tung phan) da dung san, khop Gemini.
Trung lap voi ca 14 (cung nguon/dich). Cung ket luan: tung phan cu the, truoc khi sua SuaDoi (tung phan) hop ly, khop Gemini.

DeepSeek: 'thay the ma so danh muc Muc-Tieu muc tu Muc 032 den 050' = thay the mot PHAM VI HEP (mot day ma so cu the) trong he thong muc luc rong hon cua dich = tung phan. Truoc khi sua SuaDoi (tung phan) hop ly.

Dieu 9 nguon: 'Bai bo cac quy dinh VE NHAP KHAU TRANG THIET BI Y TE tai Thong tu so 08/2006...' - dich con dieu chinh ca vac xin, hoa chat... nen day chi la tung phan theo chu de. Truoc khi sua BaiBoToanBo (toan bo) SAI, can sua tung phan - neu rule ap dung tung-phan la sua DUNG mot loi that su.

Khong doc duoc ly do Gemini day du (bi cat trong ban trich) de doi chieu voi DeepSeek (BaiBoToanBo, 'thay the toan bo'). Truoc khi sua la SuaDoi (tung phan) - can doc toan van 35314 ky tu de xac dinh dung sai chac chan.
Da xac nhan tu truoc (fork phan tich rule tu khoa): nguon co cau 'thay the cac quy dinh' voi Dieu khoan thi hanh ro rang neu ten dich - xac nhan ThayThe dung, khop truoc khi sua.
Dieu 2 nguon: 'Bai bo Dieu 4 va Dieu 11 cua Thong tu 16/2010/TT-NHNN' = tung phan cu the (2 dieu). Truoc khi sua SuaDoi (tung phan) hop ly, khop Gemini.

Dieu 2 nguon: 'thay the Phu luc 1, Quyet dinh so 10/2007/QD-BTS' = chi thay the 1 Phu luc cu the trong dich (dich con cac phan khac). Truoc khi sua ThayThe (toan bo) SAI, can sua tung phan (BaiBoTungPhan theo Gemini) - la sua DUNG mot loi that su.
